summary: Dub: reggae stripped to drums and bass, parts dropped in and out, echo and reverb throws as the lead
body: The genre is a reggae track remixed live at the desk: drums and bass carry it, everything else appears in fragments.
Arrangement: mute and unmute parts every few bars; leave space.
Production in production/dub: echo throws on snare and chords, spring reverb, filter sweeps.

Apply: pattern/one-drop on the drums, then pattern/prog-dub-common-1 on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 60–90 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
